title: TfS PCF Data Model
description: Product Carbon Footprint data exchanged according to the Together for Sustainability (TfS) PCF Data Model 3.1 and the TfS PCF Guideline for the Chemical Industry.

scopeOfPcfForm.description: Scope of the PCF declaration: data model version and system boundary.

specVersion.description: Specification of the PCF data model and version used (URN). Multiple entries are possible; one of them must be the TfS data model URN. Can be autofilled by the application.

items.description: Specification of the PCF data model and version used (URN). Multiple entries are possible; one of them must be the TfS data model URN. Can be autofilled by the application.

partialFullPcf.description: A partial PCF (cradle-to-gate) covers emissions from resource extraction until the product leaves the gate of your organization (optionally including the distribution stage). A full PCF (cradle-to-grave) covers the complete life cycle up to end-of-life.

companyAndProductInformation.description: The company reporting the PCF and the product it refers to.

companyInformation.description: The company supplying the product and reporting the PCF (data owner).

companyName.description: The (legal) name of the company supplying the product and reporting the PCF (data owner).

companyIds.description: Non-empty set of company identifiers of the data owner, each according to URN:FPI (domain of the issuing organization, entity and identifier type, identifier).

items.description: Non-empty set of company identifiers of the data owner, each according to URN:FPI (domain of the issuing organization, entity and identifier type, identifier).

productInformation.description: The product the PCF refers to and its declared unit.

productNameCompany.description: The non-empty trade name of the product, recognizable by the receiver of the PCF.

productIds.description: Non-empty set of product identifiers (e.g. supplier part number, GTIN, article number, CAS number), each according to URN:FPI.

items.description: Non-empty set of product identifiers (e.g. supplier part number, GTIN, article number, CAS number), each according to URN:FPI.

productClassifications.description: Classification or category identifiers in URN format (e.g. UN CPC, CAS number, CN code).

items.description: Classification or category identifiers in URN format (e.g. UN CPC, CAS number, CN code).

productDescription.description: Free-form description of the product (functions, technical parameters, production technology, packaging).

declaredUnitOfMeasurement.description: The declared unit to which the inputs and outputs of the PCF calculation are related.

declaredUnitAmount.description: The amount of declared units the PCF refers to. Must be strictly greater than 0.

productMassPerDeclaredUnit.description: Mass of the product in kg per declared unit amount, excluding packaging. Required especially when the declared unit is piece.

pcfAssessmentAndMethodology.description: How the PCF was assessed and which methodology was followed.

pcfAssessmentInformation.description: Identity, boundary, technology, geography and time scope of the PCF.

idAndVersion.description: Identifier and version of this PCF.

id.description: Globally unique identifier (UUID v4) of this PCF. An update requires a new PCF ID.

precedingPfIds.description: If defined, a non-empty set of identifiers (UUIDs) of the preceding product footprints.

items.description: If defined, a non-empty set of identifiers (UUIDs) of the preceding product footprints.

version.description: Pathfinder-specific version of the product carbon footprint, not used by TfS. Default for TfS is 1.

status.description: Pathfinder-specific status of the PCF, not used by TfS.

exemptedEmissionsPercent.description: Share of total emissions, in percent, excluded from the PCF by the applied cut-off criteria. Must be between 0 and 10.

exemptedEmissionsDescription.description: Rationale behind the exclusion of specific emissions. Potential cut-offs are defined in the TfS PCF Guideline.

technology.description: Processes and technologies behind the product.

boundaryProcessesDescription.description: Brief description of the significantly contributing manufacturing steps of the product, including the technologies used.

ccuCo2Origin.description: Source the CO2 is captured from (e.g. DAC / direct air capture, ammonia plant). Leave empty or enter not-applicable when not relevant.

ccsTechnologicalCO2CaptureIncluded.description: True if CCS/BECCS technology (including geological storage) has been employed. BECCS stands for Bioenergy with Carbon Capture and Storage.

geography.description: Where the product is produced (last manufacturing step).

geographyCountrySubdivision.description: Country subdivision of the production site (last manufacturing step) as an ISO 3166-2 subdivision code, e.g. DE-BY for Bavaria, Germany.

geographyCountry.description: Country of the production site (last manufacturing step) as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. US or FR.

geographyRegionOrSubregion.description: Region or subregion of the supplier production site, e.g. Global, Europe, Eastern Europe.

time.description: Reference, issue and validity periods of the PCF.

referencePeriodStart.description: Start of the data collection period for primary data sources (ISO 8601, UTC). Does not refer to publication dates of secondary data.

referencePeriodEnd.description: End of the data collection period for primary data sources (ISO 8601, UTC).

created.description: Time stamp at which the PCF was declared, independent of when or whether it was shared (ISO 8601, UTC). Represents the validity period start unless specified separately.

validityPeriodStart.description: Start of the validity period of this declaration (ISO 8601, UTC).

validityPeriodEnd.description: Expected end of the use period of this declaration or date of the expected update (ISO 8601, UTC). Resolves to 3 years after the reference period end.

pcfMethodology.description: Standards, characterization factors, allocation, mass balancing and credits applied.

standards.description: Standards and sector rules the PCF calculation is based on.

crossSectoralStandards.description: Standards the PCF calculation is based on; multiple entries are possible. The calculation standard may differ from the standard defining the communication format.

items.description: Standards the PCF calculation is based on; multiple entries are possible. The calculation standard may differ from the standard defining the communication format.

productOrSectorSpecificRules.description: The most specific product or sector rules applied (e.g. Product Category Rules, PEFCR). Predefined values or free text; should be TfS PCF Guideline V3.0.

items.description: The most specific product or sector rules applied (e.g. Product Category Rules, PEFCR). Predefined values or free text; should be TfS PCF Guideline V3.0.

gwpCharacterizationFactorDetails.description: Which IPCC assessment report the GWP values come from.

characterizationFactors.description: IPCC Assessment Report (AR) whose global warming potential values were used. Prefilled with AR6 (including carbon feedback) but changeable.

allocationInForeground.description: Allocation approaches applied to the reporting company's own processes.

allocationRulesDescription.description: Allocation rules applied to the foreground data (e.g. physical or economic allocation).

allocationWasteIncineration.description: Allocation approach applied to waste incineration with energy recovery: cut-off (recycled content approach), reverse cut-off (waste allocation) or system expansion & substitution.

allocationRecycledCarbon.description: Approach applied for material recycling: not-applicable, cut-off, cut-off plus or upstream system expansion (USE). See pages 74-75 of the TfS PCF Guideline v3.

ccuCalculationApproach.description: Approach applied for CCU: not-applicable, cut-off method or credit method. Predefined values or free text.

tfsPositivelistPcrUsed.description: Which PCR from the TfS positive list of PCRs was used for allocation, if any (https://www.tfs-initiative.com/app/uploads/2024/11/List-of-accepted-PCR-by-TfS.pdf).

systemexpansionPositivelistUsed.description: Which system expansion and substitution from the TfS positive list was used, if any (https://www.tfs-initiative.com/app/uploads/2024/11/List-of-substitued-products-Multi-output-TfS.pdf).

massBalancingInformation.description: Whether and how mass balancing was used.

massBalancingUsed.description: True if mass balancing (credit method) is used, also when combined with a rolling average. False if only a rolling average (equal distribution of inputs among outputs) is used.

freeAttributionInMassBalancing.description: Whether free attribution was applied in mass balancing. Required if massBalancingUsed is true.

massBalancingCalculationApproach.description: Mass balance calculation approach. Required if massBalancingUsed is true.

massBalancingCertificateScheme.description: Certification scheme used for mass balancing. Required if massBalancingUsed is true.

massBalancingInformation.$comment: R1: Mass balancing used requires its attribution, calculation approach and certificate scheme.

creditInformation.description: Certificate schemes and amounts for CCU, CCS and Upstream System Expansion (USE) credits.

ccuCreditCertificateScheme.description: Certification scheme used for the CCU credit method. Required if ccuCalculationApproach is credit method.

ccsTechnologicalCO2Capture.description: CO2 captured and stored. Optional, and only meaningful if ccsTechnologicalCO2CaptureIncluded is true. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

useCredit.description: Amount of the Upstream System Expansion (USE) credit. Required if allocationRecycledCarbon is upstream system expansion. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

useCreditCertificateScheme.description: Certification scheme used for Upstream System Expansion (USE). Required if allocationRecycledCarbon is upstream system expansion.

dataSourcesAndQuality.description: Primary data share, secondary data sources and data quality ratings.

primaryDataShare.description: Mandatory from 2027. Share of primary data in the final PCF, in percent (0-100).

secondaryEmissionFactorSources.description: Secondary data sources and versions used by you or your suppliers (e.g. databases such as ecoinvent).

technologicalDQR.description: Mandatory from 2027. Degree to which the data reflects the actual technologies used, rated 1-5 (fractions allowed) per Table 5.14 of the TfS PCF Guideline v3.0.

temporalDQR.description: Mandatory from 2027. Degree to which the reference period of the data set is close to the issue date, rated 1-5 (fractions allowed) per Table 5.16 of the TfS PCF Guideline v3.0.

geographicalDQR.description: Mandatory from 2027. Degree to which the data reflects the actual geographic location of the processes within the inventory boundary, rated 1-5 (fractions allowed) per Table 5.15 of the TfS PCF Guideline v3.0.

verificationAndCertificationShares.description: Shares of the PCF result backed by program certification or by first-, second- or third-party verification.

programCertificationShare.description: PCF Program Certification Share: percent of the PCF result calculated by PCF-program-certified suppliers.

productVerificationShare3rdParty.description: Third-party Product Verification Share: percent of the PCF result based on data verified by an independent third party.

productVerificationShare2ndParty.description: Second-party Product Verification Share: percent of the PCF result based on data verified by a second-party verifier.

productVerificationShare1stParty.description: First-party Product Verification Share: percent of the PCF result based on data verified by a first-party verifier.

comment.description: Any non-confidential information relevant to understand the representativeness of this PCF that the other attributes cannot carry.

pcfLegalStatement.description: Legal disclaimer applying to the publication of this PCF; may include a URL to the provider's disclaimer.

attestationOfConformance.description: Attestations of conformance (certifications, verifications, mass balance certificates) covering this PCF.

attestationType.description: Type and level of trust conveyed by this attestation of conformance. Open value list.

standardName.description: Cross-sectoral standards or product or sector rules (PCRs) the attestation of conformance is based on. Open value list.

items.description: Cross-sectoral standards or product or sector rules (PCRs) the attestation of conformance is based on. Open value list.
examples: International Aluminium Good Practice Guidance PCF v2.0

attestationStandard.description: Attestation scheme standard, e.g. PCF Verification and PCF Program Certification Framework. Open value list.

items.description: Attestation scheme standard, e.g. PCF Verification and PCF Program Certification Framework. Open value list.
examples: PCF Verification and PCF Program Certification Framework V2

attestationOfConformanceId.description: Identifiers of the certificate or verification statement used for tracking and referencing; use a UUID v4 if newly generated.

items.description: Identifiers of the certificate or verification statement used for tracking and referencing; use a UUID v4 if newly generated.

attestationOfConformanceLink.description: Link to the declaration of conformance, to verify its validity and authenticity manually.

providerName.description: Name of the issuing certifier's or verifier's legal entity. For 3rd-party PCF verification and PCF program certification only.

providerID.description: Unique identifiers of the issuing entity, such as a Business Partner Number (BPN) or another official registration number.

items.description: Unique identifiers of the issuing entity, such as a Business Partner Number (BPN) or another official registration number.

completedAt.description: Time stamp at which the attestation of conformance was issued (ISO 8601, UTC).

productLifeCycleStagesAndEmissions.description: GWP results per life cycle stage, in kg CO2e per declared unit.

packagingEmissionsIncluded.description: True if emissions of the preparation and packaging of the product are included. Sits outside the packaging group; true means the packagingStage group applies.

productionStage.description: Cradle-to-gate (gate of the producer) emissions. Packaging emissions are included here when packagingEmissionsIncluded is true.

pcfIncludingBiogenicUptake.description: Position T1 = A + B + C + D + E + F + G + H (B, D and G are negative contributions). Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

pcfExcludingBiogenicUptake.description: Position T2 = A + B + C + E + F + G + H (B and G are negative contributions). Must be >= 0. Called productionStage.pcfExcludingBiogenic in the TfS API. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

fossilGhgEmissions.description: Mandatory from 2027. Position A: all fossil emissions, including industrial processes, stationary and mobile combustion and fugitive emissions, and the fossil emissions of land management (A1). Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

technologicalCO2Removals.description: Position B (negative contribution): carbon capture and geological storage counting as a removal (e.g. BECCS, see PACT v3.0). Required only if ccsTechnologicalCO2CaptureIncluded is true AND the case is a removal; a fossil CO2 CCS that is not a removal is declared as 0. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

landManagementFossilGhgEmissions.description: Position A1: fossil emissions of land management activities (e.g. N2O from fertilizers, soil management and amendments, on-site machinery, production inputs, refrigerants, on-site waste, purchased energy; see PACT v3.0). A detail that must also be included in position A. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

biogenicNonCO2Emissions.description: Position C: non-CO2 biogenic emissions of agricultural activities (e.g. CH4 from livestock, manure, biomass burning, rice production and degradation; see PACT v3.0). N2O from land management is reported in A and A1. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

biogenicCO2Uptake.description: Position D (negative contribution): biogenic CO2 uptake in the product; if attributed by mass balancing, massBalancingUsed must be true. Required if biogenicCarbonContent is greater than 0. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

landUseChangeGhgEmissions.description: Mandatory from 2027. Position E: emissions from direct land use change (dLUC), or statistical LUC (sLUC) when dLUC data is unavailable; iLUC excluded (see PACT v3.0). Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

landManagementBiogenicCO2Emissions.description: Mandatory from 2027. Position F: biogenic CO2 emissions from a net carbon stock loss within one land use category due to agricultural practices such as tillage, pruning and harvest (see PACT v3.0). Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

landManagementBiogenicCO2Removals.description: Position G (negative contribution): net CO2 removals from net increases of carbon stored in land-based carbon pools due to ongoing land management practices (see PACT v3.0). Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

aircraftGhgEmissions.description: Position H: aviation emissions in the cradle-to-gate distribution stages, if applicable. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

packagingStage.description: Detail of the GWP contribution of the packaging. The packaging impact itself shall be included in the production stage.

packagingPcfIncludingBiogenicUptake.description: Packaging position T1 = A + B + C + D + E + F + G + H (B, D and G are negative contributions). Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

packagingPcfExcludingBiogenicUptake.description: Packaging position T2 = A + B + C + E + F + G + H (B and G are negative contributions). Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

packagingFossilGhgEmissions.description: Packaging position A: all fossil emissions, including the fossil emissions of land management (A1). Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

packagingTechnologicalCO2Removals.description: Packaging position B (negative contribution): carbon capture and geological storage counting as a removal; declared as 0 if not a removal. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

packagingLandManagementFossilGhgEmission.description: Packaging position A1: fossil emissions of land management activities; a detail that must also be included in position A. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

packagingBiogenicNonCO2Emissions.description: Packaging position C: non-CO2 biogenic emissions of agricultural activities. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

packagingBiogenicCO2Uptake.description: Packaging position D (negative contribution): biogenic CO2 uptake in the packaging. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

packagingLandUseChangeGhgEmissions.description: Packaging position E: emissions from direct (or statistical) land use change, iLUC excluded. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

packagingLandManagementBiogenicCO2Emissi.description: Packaging position F: biogenic CO2 emissions from a net carbon stock loss within one land use category. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

packagingLandManagementBiogenicCO2Remova.description: Packaging position G (negative contribution): net CO2 removals from land management practices. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

packagingAircraftGhgEmissions.description: Packaging position H: aviation emissions in the cradle-to-gate distribution stages, if applicable. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

distributionStage.description: Outbound logistics from the production gate to the customer gate.

distributionStagePcfIncludingBiogenicUpt.description: Distribution position T1 = A + B + C + D + E + F + G + H (B, D and G are negative contributions). Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

distributionStagePcfExcludingBiogenicUpt.description: Distribution position T2 = A + B + C + E + F + G + H (B and G are negative contributions). Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

distributionStageFossilGhgEmissions.description: Distribution position A: all fossil emissions, including the fossil emissions of land management (A1). Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

distributionStageTechnologicalCO2Removal.description: Distribution position B (negative contribution): carbon capture and geological storage counting as a removal; declared as 0 if not a removal. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

distributionStageLandManagementFossilGhg.description: Distribution position A1: fossil emissions of land management activities; a detail that must also be included in position A. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

distributionStageBiogenicNonCO2Emissions.description: Distribution position C: non-CO2 biogenic emissions of agricultural activities. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

distributionStageBiogenicCO2Uptake.description: Distribution position D (negative contribution): biogenic CO2 uptake. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

distributionStageLandUseChangeGhgEmissio.description: Distribution position E: emissions from direct (or statistical) land use change, iLUC excluded. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

distributionStageLandManagementBiogenicC.description: Distribution position F: biogenic CO2 emissions from a net carbon stock loss within one land use category. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.
Distribution position G (negative contribution): net CO2 removals from land management practices. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

distributionStageAircraftGhgEmissions.description: Distribution position H: aviation emissions after the production gate until the customer gate, if applicable. Unit: kg CO2e/declared unit.

carbonContent.description: Carbon content of the product, in kg C per declared unit.

carbonContentTotal.description: Total carbon content. Unit: kg C/declared unit.

fossilCarbonContent.description: Fossil carbon content. Defaults to carbonContentTotal minus biogenicCarbonContent. Unit: kg C/declared unit.

biogenicCarbonContent.description: Carbon content defined as biogenic; if attributed by mass balancing, massBalancingUsed must be true. Unit: kg C/declared unit.

packagingBiogenicCarbonContent.description: Biogenic carbon in the packaging, if packaging is included. A detail that must also be included in biogenicCarbonContent. Unit: kg C/declared unit.

recycledCarbonContent.description: Carbon content defined as recycled; if attributed by mass balancing, massBalancingUsed must be true. Unit: kg C/declared unit.

ccuCarbonContent.description: Carbon content from Carbon Capture and Utilization (CCU); under the credit method this is the amount of the credit. Required if ccuCalculationApproach is cut-off method or credit method. Unit: kg C/declared unit.

allOf.$comment: R2: The CCU credit method requires the CCU credit certificate scheme.
R3: Upstream system expansion requires the USE credit and its certificate scheme.
R4: A biogenic carbon content above 0 requires the biogenic CO2 uptake.
R5: The CCU cut-off or credit method requires the CCU-based carbon content.
